name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian // Braska's Final Aeon

effects.may: Exile Jecht, then return it transformed?

abilities.text: Whenever Jecht deals combat damage to a player, you may exile it, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
I, II — Jecht Beam — Each opponent discards a card and you draw a card.
III — Ultimate Jecht Shot — Each opponent sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
